archivePolicy: versions/ is immutable historical evidence and is never rewritten.

moves.reason: The current release declaration is authored metadata, not generated runtime data.
The canonical physical game is a top-level product boundary.
Deferred modules are optional physical-game content.
The browser review interface is an active web surface.
The HTML templates belong with the web surface that consumes them.
The simulator, policies, and experiment machinery form the Lab.
Project commands have one direct task boundary.
Content-specific task implementations live below the common task boundary.
Runtime projections are generated outputs, distinct from authored content and release metadata.
Rendered documentation, galleries, and kit output are build artifacts.
Simulation and analysis studies are evidence, distinct from observed playtests.
Observed human sessions retain their own evidence boundary.
